page.title: Free Box Breathing Exercise Online
page.meta_description: A free guided box breathing exercise in your browser: breathe in, hold, breathe out, hold, 4 seconds each. 1, 3 or 5 minutes, with optional gentle sounds.
page.lead: Follow the light around the square: breathe in for 4 seconds, hold for 4, breathe out for 4, hold for 4. Choose 1, 3 or 5 minutes. Nothing to install, nothing sent anywhere.
page.hint_idle: Get comfortable. There’s no need to force your breath.
page.hint_countdown: Get comfortable. Your first breath in is coming up.
page.hint_running: Follow the light. Breathe gently, without forcing.
page.hint_background: Paused automatically when you left this tab.
page.hint_complete: Your session is complete. Come back whenever you like.
page.sound_caption: A soft cue each time the step changes
page.aria_background: Session paused: the page was hidden.
page.read_p1: Box breathing brings your breath to a slow, even rhythm: four equal steps, like the four sides of a square. People use it to settle down before a task, after a stressful moment, or instead of reaching for their phone.
page.read_p2: Breathe gently, without forcing. If the holds feel uncomfortable, make them shorter: the aim is a calm, steady rhythm, not a performance.
page.read_p3: This exercise is not a medical treatment. If you feel dizzy or unwell, stop and breathe normally.
page.cta_title: Want your own pace, in 17 languages?
page.cta_p1: The {link} lets you set each step from 1 to 20 seconds, adds vibration on phones and offers sessions with no time limit.
page.cta_p2: It is made by the team behind {upchin}, an iPhone app that helps you take breaks from your phone with Apple's Screen Time.
page.footer: Open source, a single HTML file, no tracking, nothing stored.

readme.title: Free box breathing exercise online
readme.intro: A free guided box breathing exercise that runs in your browser, in a single HTML file.
readme.how: Follow the light around the square. Each side is one step of 4 seconds:
readme.step_in: **Breathe in**: the light runs along the top and the circle grows.
readme.step_out: **Breathe out**: the bottom side, and the circle shrinks.
readme.features: Sessions of 1, 3 or 5 minutes always end on a full cycle. A 3-second countdown comes first, an optional gentle sound marks each step, the session pauses when you leave the tab, and reduced motion settings are respected.
readme.storage: Nothing is stored and nothing is sent anywhere: no tracking, no external script, no sign-up.
readme.run: Open `index.html` in any browser. No build step and no dependency.
readme.reading_p1: Breathe gently, without forcing. If the holds feel uncomfortable, make them shorter: the aim is a calm, steady rhythm, not a performance.
readme.reading_p2: This exercise is not a medical treatment. If you feel dizzy or unwell, stop and breathe normally.
